title: Order Processing Workflow
description: Complete guide to processing orders from receipt to fulfillment, including status management and shipping.
content:
Order Processing Workflow

Understanding the order processing workflow helps you fulfill orders efficiently and keep customers informed throughout the process.

Order Statuses

Orders progress through several statuses:

  • Pending: Order received, awaiting payment
  • Processing: Payment received, preparing for shipment
  • Shipped: Order has been shipped
  • Delivered: Order delivered to customer
  • Cancelled: Order cancelled
  • Refunded: Order refunded

Order Processing Steps

Step 1: Order Received

When a customer places an order:

  • You receive an email notification
  • Order appears in Orders list
  • Order status is "Pending"
  • Payment is processed (if applicable)

Step 2: Verify Payment

Check that payment was successful:

  • View order details
  • Check payment status
  • Verify payment amount
  • For manual payments, mark as paid

Step 3: Update Status to Processing

Once payment is confirmed:

  • Change status to "Processing"
  • Customer receives confirmation email
  • Order is ready for fulfillment

Step 4: Prepare Order

Prepare the order for shipment:

  • Verify product availability
  • Pack items
  • Print packing slip
  • Print shipping label

Step 5: Ship Order

When order is shipped:

  • Update status to "Shipped"
  • Add tracking number
  • Customer receives shipping notification

Step 6: Delivery Confirmation

Once delivered:

  • Update status to "Delivered"
  • Request customer review
  • Close the order

Order Actions

Available actions per order:

  • View Details: View complete order information
  • Edit: Modify order details
  • Print Invoice: Generate invoice PDF
  • Print Packing Slip: Generate packing slip
  • Update Status: Change order status
  • Add Note: Internal notes about order
  • Send Email: Send email to customer
  • Refund: Process refund
  • Cancel: Cancel the order

Bulk Operations

Process multiple orders at once:

  • Bulk status update
  • Bulk print invoices
  • Bulk print shipping labels
  • Bulk email notifications

Customer Communication

Keep customers informed:

  • Order confirmation emails
  • Payment confirmation
  • Shipping notifications
  • Delivery confirmations
  • Custom email templates

Handling Issues

Payment Issues

  • Failed payments
  • Partial payments
  • Payment disputes
  • Refunds

Shipping Issues

  • Out of stock items
  • Shipping delays
  • Lost packages
  • Damaged items

Automation

Automate common tasks:

  • Auto-update status after payment
  • Auto-send confirmation emails
  • Auto-generate shipping labels
  • Auto-update inventory

Best Practices

  • Process orders within 24 hours
  • Keep customers informed
  • Use clear order statuses
  • Track everything
  • Handle issues promptly
  • Document special cases
